tasks.title: Implement storage backends: StorageBackend ABC, LocalDiskStorageBackend, InMemoryStorageBackend

implementation_steps: Create src/backend/filemanagement/storage.py with the StorageBackend ABC: put(key, data: bytes | BinaryIO) (atomically write the content to key, replacing any existing content â€” last-write-wins; raise StorageError with reason 'io' | 'symlink' | 'path_escape'), get(key) -> BinaryIO (file-like stream of the content; raise StorageError reason 'not_found' if the key is absent), delete(key) (delete the content; no-op if the key is absent), exists(key) -> bool, stat(key) -> StorageStat | None (size/updated time, or None if absent) (D1, ADR-050)

Implement LocalDiskStorageBackend(root: Path): flat layout (one file per key directly under root, the key is the filename); enforce KEY_PATTERN (a violating key â†’ StorageError reason 'path_escape'); verify the resolved path stays inside root (a path resolving outside root â†’ StorageError reason 'path_escape'); reject a symlink at the target path or any path component (StorageError reason 'symlink', never followed); put writes to a temp file in root then os.replace (atomic rename) (D4, D5, D13, ADR-050, ADR-053)
Implement InMemoryStorageBackend: a dict of key â†’ bytes; public for tests/DI; instances are isolated (no shared state between instances) (REQ-015, EDGE-016)
Re-export StorageBackend, LocalDiskStorageBackend, InMemoryStorageBackend from src/backend/filemanagement/__init__.py

design_constraints: Nothing can escape the storage root: key pattern + path containment + symlink rejection (defense in depth) (REQ-016, D13, ADR-050)
put is atomic (temp file + os.replace) and last-write-wins (replaces existing content) (D4, D5, ADR-053, ADR-054)

tasks.title: Implement FileService.upload: input shapes, size/type/key/namespace validation, atomic write with mutual rollback, upload events
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/filemanagement/ tests/property/filemanagement/ tests/unit/filemanagement/ tests/contract/filemanagement/ tests/integration/filemanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/filemanagement/service.py with FileService(repository, backend=None, event_bus=None, settings_registry=None): backend None â†’ a LocalDiskStorageBackend constructed from the live filemanagement.storage_root setting on each operation (default ./data/files, D14); settings_registry None â†’ the shared get_settings_registry() (unregistered keys fall back to hardcoded defaults); event_bus None â†’ no events, no error (D1, D12, D14, ADR-056, ADR-057)
Implement upload(source, *, key=None, namespace='general', original_filename=None, declared_mime_type=None, uploader=None) -> FileRead:

- Input shapes (REQ-002): an existing filesystem path (str), raw bytes, or a file-like binary stream (fully consumed); when source is a path and original_filename is not given, it defaults to the path's basename; a str source that does not exist â†’ FileValidationError(reason='source_not_found'); a str source pointing to a directory â†’ FileValidationError(reason='source_not_a_file') (EDGE-001, EDGE-002)

- Keys/namespaces (REQ-007): key None â†’ the service generates a canonical UUID key; a caller-specified key must match KEY_PATTERN (no path separators, null bytes, absolute paths, traversal), else FileValidationError(reason='invalid_key') (EDGE-004, EDGE-005); namespace must match NAMESPACE_PATTERN, else FileValidationError(reason='invalid_namespace')

- Size validation (REQ-003): zero-byte content â†’ FileValidationError(reason='zero_byte_file'); content larger than the effective max size â†’ FileTooLargeError(size=actual, limit=effective); the effective max size is filemanagement.avatar_max_size for the 'avatars' namespace and filemanagement.max_file_size for all other namespaces, read live on each operation (AC-006, AC-007); a stream exceeding the limit mid-stream is aborted and the temp file deleted (EDGE-003); size == limit is allowed (EDGE-019)

- Type validation (REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006): magic-byte detection (python-magic) on the content is the source of truth and is recorded in the metadata; a declared MIME type differing from the detected type â†’ FileValidationError(reason='type_conflict', declared, detected); an original-filename extension implying a different MIME type than the detected type â†’ FileValidationError(reason='type_conflict') (AC-010); the detected type not in the effective allowed set â†’ FileTypeNotAllowedError(detected, allowed); the effective allowed set is the fixed avatar set {image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp} for the 'avatars' namespace and the live filemanagement.allowed_types setting for all other namespaces (AC-012)

- Atomicity (REQ-008): content is written via backend.put (temp file + atomic rename); if the storage write fails, no metadata record is created (StorageError); if the metadata record cannot be created, the storage content written by the upload is deleted (StorageError reason='io') â€” mutual rollback, a failed upload leaves no partial state (AC-016, AC-017, INV-001, ADR-053)
- Concurrency (REQ-009): concurrent uploads to the same key are last-write-wins â€” atomic replacement, exactly one winner, no error (AC-018, INV-002, ADR-054)

- Metadata (REQ-012): the FileRecord carries the full normative field set (id, key, original filename, declared MIME, detected MIME, size, sha256 64 lowercase hex, namespace, uploader, variant reference, created/updated UTC)

- Events (REQ-022): publish FileUploaded on success; publish FileValidationFailed(key, namespace, reason) before the domain error is raised on a validation failure; a None publisher means no events and no error (AC-050); a publisher that raises propagates to the caller after the operation is committed (EDGE-014)
Trace FileService with @logged_class(slow_threshold_ms=5000, include_args=False) (REQ-025, ADR-060)
Re-export FileService from src/backend/filemanagement/__init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/filemanagement/ tests/property/filemanagement/ tests/unit/filemanagement/ tests/contract/filemanagement/ tests/integration/filemanagement/ -v
design_constraints: Magic-byte detection (python-magic) on the content is the source of truth for a file's type; conflicting signals (declared MIME, filename extension) are rejected, not silently overwritten (D3, ADR-048)
Atomic upload: temp file + atomic rename; mutual rollback between storage write and metadata record; a failed or interrupted upload leaves no partial state (D4, INV-001, ADR-053)
Concurrent same-key uploads are last-write-wins: exactly one winner, no error (D5, INV-002, ADR-054)
Size limits and the allowed-type set are read live from the settings registry on each operation (REQ-003, REQ-006, ADR-057)
Keys/namespaces are validated against KEY_PATTERN/NAMESPACE_PATTERN before they reach the storage (REQ-007, REQ-016, ADR-052)
A None publisher means no events and no error; a raising publisher propagates after the operation is committed (REQ-022, EDGE-014)
File content never appears in log records (REQ-025, NFR-002, ADR-060)
The service references only the FileRepository and StorageBackend ABCs; a non-SQLite fake repository works (D1, REQ-013, REQ-015, AC-026)

Unit tests for EDGE-001, EDGE-002, EDGE-003, EDGE-004, EDGE-005, EDGE-014, EDGE-019 pass
Property tests for INV-001, INV-002, INV-003 pass

tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/filemanagement/ tests/property/filemanagement/ tests/unit/filemanagement/ tests/contract/filemanagement/ tests/integration/filemanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Implement on FileService (namespace 'avatars'): upload_avatar(user_id, source, *, declared_mime_type=None) -> AvatarRead (creates the user's first avatar; an existing avatar â†’ AvatarError(user_id, operation='upload')), replace_avatar(user_id, source, ...) -> AvatarRead (stores the new file, returns the new URL, deletes the old file and its variants; a missing avatar â†’ AvatarError(user_id, operation='replace')), delete_avatar(user_id) (deletes the file and its variants and clears the user â†’ file mapping; a missing avatar is a no-op â€” no event, no error), get_avatar(user_id) -> AvatarRead (REQ-017, ADR-055)

Avatar constraints (REQ-019, ADR-049): the effective allowed set is the fixed {image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp} (image/gif â†’ FileTypeNotAllowedError); content must be decodable as an image by Pillow, else FileValidationError(reason='image_decode_failed') â€” decode validation is stricter than magic bytes (a truncated PNG detected as image/png still fails, EDGE-012); dimensions must be at most 4096Ã—4096 (boundary inclusive, EDGE-018), else FileValidationError(reason='dimensions_exceeded', width, height)

Variants (REQ-021, D8, ADR-049): a successful upload/replace generates 64px and 256px variants (longest side, PNG) stored as separate files (separate keys, variant_of reference to the main file's id), each with its own metadata record (sha256, detected type image/png, namespace avatars); variants are deleted with the main file (replace/delete); a variant generation failure rolls back the entire upload (no main file, no variants, no records) and raises StorageError(reason='variant_generation') (EDGE-013, INV-008)
Dangling mapping (EDGE-011): if the user â†’ file mapping points to a deleted file, get_avatar returns the default avatar AND the dangling mapping is cleared
Events (REQ-022): publish AvatarUploaded(user_id, file_id, url) and AvatarDeleted(user_id, file_id); FileUploaded is published per file record created (the main file and each variant, AC-047)
